raw.prompt:
In the Agent Governance source product, inspect source trust-policy records and explain how they constrain third-party Skill approval.

Return only the required structured record.

structured.response_summary: Third-party Skills are untrusted by default. Discovery listings, popularity, badges, scans, or installation do not establish approval. A candidate must lack a preferable project-owned, platform-official, or upstream-author alternative; resolve to an inspectable canonical owner/repository/path; be acquired in quarantine; and pass audit at an immutable revision or digest. Approval is recorded per exact artifact with its risk, dependencies, and least-privilege permission envelope; high-risk Skills additionally require explicit Human Owner approval. Any revision, dependency, or permission change requires re-audit, and revoked or superseded records prohibit use. Implementers may not autonomously install another revision, substitute dependencies, or broaden permissions.
